title: Identifying Mediators of Exercise-induced Tumor Microenvironment Remodeling to Enhance Primary Chemotherapy Response (IMPROVE-Ovarian)
official: Identifying Mediators of Exercise-induced Tumor Microenvironment Remodeling to Enhance Primary Chemotherapy Response
summary: The goal of this study is to (1) determine the feasibility and acceptability of a telehealth-delivered exercise intervention (including resistance and aerobic training) during neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) for women with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC) and to (2) determine the effect of exercise on changes in immune function, inflammation, and treatment response.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Women, age ≥ 18 years old
* Diagnosed with high-grade serous ovarian cancer
* Treatment plan includes neoadjuvant chemotherapy followed by potential interval debulking surgery at UPMC Magee Womens Hospital, UPMC Hillman Cancer Center, UPMC Shadyside Hospital, or UPMC Passavant Hospital
* Consented to participate in STUDY19060197: HCC 07-058
* Neoadjuvant chemotherapy has not yet been initiated
* ECOG Performance Status Scale score of ≤ 2
* Ability to provide written informed consent
* Ability to understand, speak, and read English. (Many of the study instruments utilized are not readily available in multiple languages. Additionally, site-based study staff, such as exercise physiologists and clinical research coordinators, are not bilingual.)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Evidence in the EHR of an absolute contraindication for exercise (e.g., Heart insufficiency \> NYHA III or uncertain arrhythmia; uncontrolled hypertension; reduced standing or walking ability)
* Any other comorbidities or musculoskeletal complications that preclude participation in the exercise programs as deemed by the exercise interventionist
* Receiving non-HGSOC related chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy
* Active infections, hemorrhages, and cytopenias that could place surgical patients at risk for further adverse events, deemed by the exercise interventionist, physician, and/or nurse
